title: The Tortoise and the Hare
synopsis: A group of adventurous rabbits enters a forbidden ancient tomb in search of the legendary Golden Tortoise. Their confidence is tested when they discover that the enemy they expected may be far more dangerous than they imagined.
awards: Audience Choice — Higgsfield Global Film Festival 2026
